description: Structural engineering and building control drawings supporting construction of the already-approved single-storey side and rear extension at The Gables, Great Leighs.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Having secured planning permission for a single-storey side and rear extension at The Gables, Banters Lane, Great Leighs, the Paynes needed the scheme carried through to a buildable set of drawings.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE developed the approved planning drawings into full structural engineering and building control information, ready for the builder to price and construct from.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Chelmsford City Council had granted full planning permission for the extension in August 2018 (application ref. 18/01184/FUL); this later phase of work carried that approved scheme through to construction-ready drawings.

note: Same property as '09 Julia Payne'; this folder covers the later structural/building-control phase.
